question.text: What is the typical face value of a unit in a mutual fund scheme?

explanation.text: The Logic: Typically, every unit has a face value of Rs 10. The Trap: Face value is distinct from NAV; the workbook specifies Rs 10 as the face value of a mutual fund unit, while NAV fluctuates based on the value of the underlying portfolio. Note: Use the Rs 10 face-value figure as the source-backed answer for mutual fund units.
